title: Situational Awareness x Eval Gaming: When the Model Knows It Is Being Monitored

original_idea.body: Compare an open model's behavior and CoT on identical control tasks under monitoring-signaling vs neutral prompts, measuring the flagged-behavior gap and CoT informativeness.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Isolates how monitoring-awareness shifts apparent safety, bearing on a named Anthropic open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt-only monitored-vs-neutral comparison; accessible to a motivated beginner.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused behavior/CoT gap measurement; few dependencies.

novelty.reasoning: Evaluation-awareness behavioral effects are an active 2026 topic with several direct papers.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Eval-awareness behavioral effect is heavily studied in 2026 control literature.
